findings.title: Use the V2 release tag consistently in both server preloads
findings.trigger: Any V2 resource diagnostic starts its normal compiled server with the generated launch environment.
findings.actualBehavior: diagnosticPlan sets PAPERCLIP_RESOURCE_COUNTER_RELEASE=combined-h5e-resource-v2 and counter-preload requires that value, but unchanged pg-service-preload still asserts combined-h5e-resource-v1. The second import therefore rejects before the PG startup seam. Setting V1 instead would fail the counter preload, so no single launch environment can satisfy both.
findings.impact: Every V2 serving qualification is blocked before PG/app readiness despite the pure/type/discovery checks passing.

actualSourceProof.scope: Node node:vm runs the actual extracted assertions against diagnosticPlan output; no preload, app or OS process is started.

findings.requiredCorrection: Publish a new packet with the intended V2 release tag shared by launcher, counter preload and PG preload; retain the separate-release assertions. Add a pure test executing both actual early release-tag assertions against diagnosticPlan output so discovery/type checks cannot hide this mismatch.
